rationale: Colin's work bridging GPU cloud infrastructure with developer needs at Nebius complements Chinguun's full-stack development background in Python and TypeScript — Colin can offer deep insight into the infrastructure layer that powers the tools Chinguun builds. As an FDE at Starch, Chinguun represents exactly the kind of hands-on builder Colin engages with through Dabl.Club and his developer relations strategy, making this a natural fit for ecosystem exploration and technical collaboration.
intro_message: Colin Nebius, meet Chinguun Ganbaatar — Colin bridges AI infrastructure and developer tools at Nebius while building SF's Dabl.Club community, and Chinguun's full-stack experience at Starch could benefit from Colin's perspective on purpose-built inference infrastructure for production applications.
